28:     name = "read_file"
29:     description = "Read a text file from the repository. Returns its contents with line numbers."
30:     parameters = {"type": "object", "properties": {"path": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["path"]}
31: 
32:     async def run(self, args: dict[str, Any], ctx: ToolContext) -> ToolResult:
33:         try:
34:             p = resolve(ctx, str(args["path"]))
35:             text = p.read_text(errors="replace")
36:         except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
37:             return _err(e)
38:         numbered = "\n".join(f"{i + 1}: {ln}" for i, ln in enumerate(text.splitlines()))
